newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips seen up at open, extending rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips seen up at open, extending rally.

text.p: U.S. blue chip shares were seen opening higher on Wednesday, still enthusiastic after Federal Reserve policy makers opted to leave short-term interest rates alone at yesterday's meeting.

Economic data which showed a 19.3 percent narrowing of the U.S. trade gap in March to $8.51 billion caused treasury bonds to soften in early trade. But stocks would still likely bask a bit longer in the Federal Open Market Committee decision to keep the federal funds rate at 5.5 percent, analysts said.
The S&P 500 futures index was up 1.45 points to 846.00 while the long bond was off 9/32 at 6.93 percent.
